CONT_0001 Item does not exist or is inaccessible (former HIFLD Open item).

Current official NERC page is a Code|Name table of certified Reliability Coordinators (BCRC, ERCOT, FRCC, HQT, ISNE, MISO, NBSO, NYIS, ONT, PJM, RCW, SPC, SOCO, SPP/SPPW, TVA, VACS, AESO). No polygons, no machine-readable GIS.
3,356 URLs enumerated; no GIS/shapefile/geojson/KMZ/map-download endpoints; only glossary and program pages mention Reliability Coordinators.

Four public items; owners are sarah.idczak_DEQ (OR DEQ subset, 2025-08-26), HSEMA_PPD (DC agency, 2023-02-06), Ali.Rebollo (individual, 2021-02-25), tporetro (web map, 2018-02-12). None owned by NERC, ORNL, or a DHS HIFLD account.

WECC SPDP 'NERC RCs' Feature Service, owner chelsandrews (WECC org z5VWEXupJpBJnZRq), modified 2025-03-26; self-described 'Approximate boundaries of the Reliability Coordinators within North America'. WECC is a NERC Regional Entity, not the producing agency, and disclaims sourcing authority ('receives data from a wide variety of sources').

ORNL OpenEnergyDataPortal shell: has_records false, records_count 0, attachments [], alternative_exports [], dcat creator 'HostedByHIFLD', issued 2017-09-19, created 2025-11-18. A HIFLD harvest placeholder, not a maintained feed.
CKAN search API retired (404). The SciCrunch-harvested catalog.data.gov record (published 2017-01-01) exposes no resources.
